                        event_id,
                        intact,
                        mode,
                        temperature,
                        coolant_filled,
                        heated_coolant_filled,
                        fuel_filled,
                        waste_filled,
                        actual_burn_rate,
                        target_burn_rate,
                        damage_percent,
                        heating_rate,
                        boil_efficiency,
                        stored_kinetic_energy,
                        energy_production_rate
                    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
